organiser.name: Laneway Festival (part of Ticketek Entertainment Group, TEG)

add_sources.note: Official Sydney page: Centennial Park, Fri 12 Feb 2027.
'Laneway Festival is part of the Ticketek Entertainment Group (TEG)' (Google snippet). Touring arm @lanewaypresents.
Live review titled 'Laneway Festival, Centennial Park, Sydney (08.02.26)' (Google snippet). Sydney 2026 sold out per https://www.instagram.com/p/DThIc0OkQ1b/.
Scaled-back 2027 tour opens in Sydney on 12 February (Google snippet).
Sponsorship enquiries: lucy@aeroplaneagency.com. Media: media@lanewayfestival.com.au. General: info@lanewayfestival.com.au.

2026 Afterpay Access Area near the main stages (elevated viewing for Afterpay app users). 2027 pre-sale 'presented by Afterpay' per https://www.timeout.com/sydney/news/how-to-get-tickets-to-laneway-in-sydney-2027-pre-sale-date-line-up-more-093026 (Google snippet).
Paid partnership: weekend weather forecasts 'brought to you by @endthetrendaus' with sun-safety messaging (SPF50+, hats, shade).
'Solar Slice' across Laneway 2026 in partnership with FEAT. Artists: $1 from every ticket to nature restoration, emissions cuts and social impact.
2027 Sydney and Melbourne: 16 to 17 year olds must attend with an 18+ Responsible Adult under the Youth Policy.
